snippets.react:
import { Form, Input, Button, Stack, Heading } from '@design-schema/react';

const fields = (
  <Stack gap="normal">
    <Input label="Email address" name="email" type="email" required autocomplete="email" />
    <Input
      label="Password"
      name="password"
      type="password"
      required
      autocomplete="current-password"
      description="At least 8 characters."
    />
  </Stack>
);

const actions = (
  <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="tight" align="start">
    <Button label="Sign in" type="submit" />
    <Button label="Cancel" variant="secondary" />
  </Stack>
);

<Stack gap="normal">
  <Heading id="form-labelled-by-heading" level="2">
    Sign in
  </Heading>
  <Form
    name="sign-in"
    actions={actions}
    labelledBy="form-labelled-by-heading"
  >{fields}</Form>
</Stack>
